name: Quaderno
summary: Quaderno calculates sales tax, VAT and GST in milliseconds, sends alerts when a seller crosses a threshold in a new place, and issues invoices, including e-invoices. It says it can file returns directly with authorities in more than 40 jurisdictions. Plans are priced by monthly transaction volume, from 25 transactions upward.

facts.text: All Quaderno plans come with a 7-day free trial and no credit card is required.
A transaction is any sale, refund or purchase recorded in the app, and exceeding the limit moves an account to the next tier instead of adding overage fees.
Filing and registration are not itemized in the plan grid, and Quaderno asks sellers to book a call for details.
Quaderno states GDPR compliance, a 99.99% uptime SLA and Visma Security Program Gold, and lists no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certificate on its homepage.
API calls are capped at 10 times the plan's included transactions.
